identity.title: Bounded Autonomous Public-Research Cycle on PR254
identity.objective: Compose existing PR254 public NBA discovery/scoring/outcome engine into at most twelve finite, automatically timed, durable non-economic research cycles; preserve native denominators; never grant account, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert six additive public research files; original PR254 source/tests, canonical records, CC live canary and all protected sources untouched.
